info.title: openconfig-spanning-tree
info.description:
This module defines configuration and operational state data for the spanning tree protocol.

**Module:** `openconfig-spanning-tree`
**Root nodes:** stp
**Paths:** 34 | **Operations:** 94

GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE for config nodes, GET-only for state (config false) nodes.
